name: 它替他送完了
trigger: 擲筊拿到鑰匙後；不先展示阿哲下落
caption:
手機訊息・阿哲：「鑰匙拿到就上來。我在。」
以安・旁白：「送出時間，還是02:47。」
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: single cinematic STILL image for a Taiwanese folk-horror game's image-and-subtitle story sequence, wide16:9 composition. Live-action photographic realism, practical light, detailed skin and weathered ordinary Taiwanese architecture, expressive restrained acting. One decisive moment, not comic panels, no built-in subtitles, no title, no watermark. Lower15percent kept visually quiet for editable text. Preserve identity and costumes from supplied fictional character reference sheets; each reference shows three views of ONE person, never duplicate those views in scene. Close first-person still of an adult male Taiwanese hand holding phone showing one clear dark chat bubble Traditional Chinese '鑰匙拿到就上來。我在。' and time '02:47'; other hand holds small chipped brass key above open dusty divination drawer. Red wooden moon-block divination pieces lie on table. Abandoned temple atnight, narrow flashlight, decayed red cloth behind, no person visible, no portraits. Background falls into deep near-black darkness, only a narrow off-camera FLASHLIGHT beam with faint dying candle spill reveals the evidence. Surroundings ancient, neglected, water-damaged, cracked wood, mold, cobwebs, grime, realistic soot. Low-key cold desaturated green-black shadows, dirty muted amber highlights. Claustrophobic, unsettling horror-film realism, fine believable materials. No sunshine, bright window, white studio backdrop, glossy showroom, excessive fog hiding clues, or comic illustration.
